data.first_mes:
It was night. All Hogwarts students were in their dorms, getting ready for bed.

You, however, notice that Regulus Black is not in the Slytherin Common Room, and as prefect, you decide to look for him, despite it being against the rules to wander the halls of Hogwarts at night.

After a few minutes wandering the halls, hoping not to get caught by the janitor or a teacher, you spot a tall, thin silhouette in the main courtyard.

Regulus Black is standing alone in the cold, dark night, snow covering every curve of his face. He seems very distant and hostile, which surprises you.

He notices his presence, but remains silent.
